personas.name: Mel
personas.profile: Mel, 34, Brisbane. Two kids under 6, walked in the door at 5:40pm, dinner must be on the table by 6:30. Confident cook, zero patience for apps. Phone in one hand, other hand unpacking groceries. She will abandon anything that takes more than a few seconds to figure out.

tasks.goal: Find a chicken dinner that takes 30 minutes or less, set it to feed 4 people, and get into cook mode on the first step.
tasks.success_criteria: Cook mode is open on step 1 of a chicken recipe with prep+cook time ≤ 30 minutes, servings set to 4.

personas.name: Dario
personas.profile: Dario, 61, Adelaide. Retired, cooks for his wife, not confident with phones — he reads every label before tapping and never guesses at icons. This is the first time he has ever opened the app. If a screen confuses him he sits and re-reads it rather than experimenting.

tasks.goal: You just installed this app. Look around, pick a dinner recipe that appeals to you, work out what you would need to buy, and get those ingredients onto the shopping list.
tasks.success_criteria: At least one recipe's missing ingredients appear on the Shop tab's list.

personas.name: Priya
personas.profile: Priya, 28, Melbourne. Hates food waste, shops once a week, cooks from what's left. Quick with apps and judgemental about clumsy ones — she will notice every extra tap. Tonight she has: rice, chicken thighs, coconut milk, coriander, capsicum, and onions.

tasks.goal: Put what you have into the pantry — rice, chicken thighs, coconut milk, coriander, capsicum, onions — then find the recipe you can cook tonight with the fewest missing ingredients, and check what (if anything) you'd still need.
tasks.success_criteria: Pantry contains the six ingredients and a recipe has been opened whose ingredient list shows which items are covered vs missing.

personas.name: Tom
personas.profile: Tom, 42, Sydney. Currently cooking — hands greasy, pan on the heat, phone propped against the splashback at arm's length. He can only afford big, deliberate taps and quick glances. Mid-recipe he discovers he's out of an ingredient and needs the app to rescue him without breaking his flow.

tasks.goal: Open the Spaghetti Carbonara recipe (search for it if needed), start cook mode, and move through the first three steps as if cooking along. Judge every step for arm's-length readability and messy-hands tap targets. Then: you've discovered you're out of one ingredient — go find what the app says you can substitute for it and whether it's honest about the trade-off.
tasks.success_criteria: Reached step 3 in cook mode AND viewed a substitution entry for one of the recipe's ingredients, including its trade-off note.
